sources.title: GitHub - Kent0n-Li/ChatDoctor
sources.snippet: This model serves as the foundation for ChatDoctor, enabling it to analyze patients' symptoms and medical history, provide accurate diagnoses, and suggest appropriate treatment options. The ChatDoctor model is designed to simulate a conversation between a doctor and a patient, using natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning techniques.

sources.title: GitHub - ashesh-12/medical-llm-finetuning-qlora-mistral7b
sources.snippet: 📌 Overview This project fine-tunes Mistral 7B on the ChatDoctor-HealthCareMagic-100k dataset using QLoRA — a memory-efficient technique that fits a 7-billion parameter model on a single free-tier GPU (15GB VRAM).

sources.snippet: Medical ChatDoctor — Fine-tuned Mistral 7B A Mistral-7B model fine-tuned on the ChatDoctor-HealthCareMagic-100k dataset using QLoRA (4-bit quantization) and Unsloth for 2x faster training.
